# Mario Seijo

> Founder and Web Strategist at Minimo Studio. 25 years in tech; now practices a strategy-first, minimalist approach — stripping away the noise until a business, and its website, say one clear thing. This site is a digital business card: its purpose is to let people who have met Mario connect with him and save his contact.

Based in Seattle, WA. Peruvian-born, bilingual (English/Spanish). His method, "The Strategy-First Build", puts strategy before design: human-led discovery, expert insight, and AI tools applied only after the strategy is locked.
